Actually N is within w region; moving w left might shift N relative? Not sure.

Given time constraints, perhaps the level is solved by simply moving any N onto the small W, which might trigger level completion. Since right movement blocked, maybe need to move N up then right then down? Let's try moving UP (maybe N moves up into empty space then right).
